description: Create evidence-linked enterprise and solution architecture views with consistent Mermaid sources, local SVG/PNG rendering, cross-view coverage and independent source and pixel review.

requires.python: >=3.9 standard library; Unix env -S and no-follow regular files
requires.renderer: Node >=22; external npm ci from bundled lock: Mermaid CLI 11.17.0, Mermaid 11.17.2, Puppeteer 25.11.0; explicitly selected local chrome-headless-shell; host invokes renderer under network-denied Cage
requires.model: Operator-configured Ask model and credentials; none bundled
requires.inputs: Current request and explicitly staged architecture handoffs, facts and standards; no sibling runtime dependency
requires.review: Independent source fidelity and actual SVG/PNG pixel review against QUALITY.md; authoring/render checks do not establish approval or professional quality
